# hostereo_instance (Data Source)

Look up one of your instances by `id` or `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hostereo_instance" "web" {
  name = "web-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `cpu` (Number)
- `created_at` (String)
- `deletion_protection` (Boolean)
- `disk_gb` (Number)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `locked` (Boolean)
- `memory_mb` (Number)
- `plan_id` (String)
- `plan_name` (String)
- `region` (String) Region slug.
- `region_id` (String)
- `status` (String)
